entity: Tesla's Fremont plant and its Bay Area Air District violation notices and enforcement since 2019
what_we_add: second of 86 plants; notices on 133 days; peers' median 28 formal actions per 100 notices; Phillips 66 Rodeo 213 notices
why: The notice count matched: SFGATE has 369 in five years and Richmondside 374 for 2015-25, both close to 356. The 'no district enforcement order' claim is contradicted: the district's own June 2024 release and KTVU report an abatement order against the Fremont paint shop from its enforcement arm, and KQED reports a $1M district settlement in 2021, both inside 'since 2019'.
